title: 打电话给网络运营商报修家里断网
titleEn: Calling your internet provider about an NBN dropout
scene: 周日下午，家里的网从昨晚开始就断断续续，今天上午干脆完全连不上了。明天你要在家办公（work from home），孩子周一也要用平板做作业。你打电话给网络运营商 SwiftNet 的客服，接电话的是技术支持 Josh。他会先核实身份，再让你一步步检查设备、重启路由器，然后做线路测试（line test）。
你的目标：① 说清楚问题从什么时候开始、有什么症状；② 跟着他的指示操作，听懂 "NBN box 的灯""关电源等 30 秒" 这类指令；③ 拿到报修单号（reference number）、技术员上门的时间段，并问清楚断网期间能不能有备用网络或账单减免（credit），最后要求短信确认。

facts.v: Dropping out since last night, no connection at all since this morning
Tuesday, 8 am – 12 pm (someone over 18 must be home)

vocab.ex: The internet keeps dropping out every ten minutes.

vocab.zh: 墙上那个 NBN 接入设备（不是路由器）
vocab.ex: Can you have a look at the NBN box on the wall?

vocab.zh: 常亮的灯 / 闪烁的灯
vocab.ex: The power light is solid green, but the DSL light is flashing orange.

vocab.en: turn it off at the wall
vocab.zh: 把墙上插座的电源关掉
vocab.ex: Turn the modem off at the wall and give it thirty seconds.
Have you tried power cycling the modem?
I'll just run a line test from my end.
Is there an outage in my area?

vocab.en: on the NBN side / at our end
vocab.zh: 在 NBN 那边 / 在我们这边（指故障出在哪）
vocab.ex: It looks like the fault is on the NBN side, not your modem.

vocab.en: raise a ticket / log a fault
vocab.ex: I'll raise a ticket with NBN for you now.

vocab.zh: 上门的时间段（不是准确时间）
vocab.ex: The appointment window is between eight and twelve.

vocab.zh: 4G 备用网络 / 用手机开热点
vocab.ex: Your modem has 4G backup, so you'll still have some internet.

vocab.zh: 账户里的减免金额（抵下期账单）
vocab.ex: We'll put a credit on your account for the days you were offline.

listening.en: Thanks for calling SwiftNet, you're speaking with Josh. How're you going today?
listening.sound: “How're you going” 连读成 “howya goin'”，是澳洲版的 How are you，不是问你去哪儿；“you're speaking with” 很快，听到名字 Josh 就行。
listening.zh: 感谢致电 SwiftNet，我是 Josh。你今天好吗？
listening.reply: Not too bad, thanks. My internet's been dropping out since last night.

listening.en: No worries, I'll just need to verify a couple of things first — can I grab the full name on the account?
listening.sound: “grab” 在这里是“要一下、问一下”；“couple of” 读成 “cuppla”；“verify” 核实身份，后面通常问姓名、地址、生日。
listening.zh: 没问题，我先核实几件事——账户上的全名是什么？

listening.en: Righto, can you have a squiz at the NBN box and tell me what lights you've got?
listening.sound: “Righto” = 好的；“have a squiz” 是澳洲俚语，= have a look 看一眼；“what lights you've got” 连读成 “wot-lights-yuv-got”。
listening.zh: 好嘞，你能看一眼 NBN 盒子，告诉我亮着哪些灯吗？
listening.reply: The power light is solid green, but the one that says 'Optical' is off.

listening.en: Okay, turn the modem off at the wall, give it a good thirty seconds, then flick it back on.
listening.sound: “off at the wall” 连成 “offat-the-wall”；“flick it back on” = 把开关拨回去打开，“flick it” 读成 “flickit”。
listening.zh: 好，把路由器在墙上关掉电源，等足 30 秒，再打开。
listening.reply: Okay, it's off. I'll wait thirty seconds and turn it back on.

listening.en: Yeah, look, the line test's come back with a fault on the NBN side, so it's not your gear — I'll have to get a tech out.
listening.sound: “Yeah, look” 只是开场填充词；“test's come back” = test has come back；“gear” = 设备；“get a tech out” = 派技术员上门。
listening.zh: 嗯，线路测试显示故障在 NBN 那边，不是你的设备问题——得派个技术员来。
listening.reply: Just to confirm, you mean someone has to come to my house?

listening.en: Earliest I can do is Tuesday, eight till twelve, and someone over eighteen needs to be there to let 'em in.
listening.sound: “eight till twelve” = 8 点到 12 点之间（时间段）；“let 'em in” = let them in，'em 读成 /əm/。
listening.zh: 最早只能约周二，8 点到 12 点，需要有一个 18 岁以上的人在家开门。
listening.reply: Tuesday works. I'm working from home, so I'll be there.

speech.topic: 讲一次家里断网的经历，以及你是怎么解决的
paragraphs: I want to talk about a time when our home internet stopped working. It started on a Saturday night. The Wi-Fi kept dropping out, and by Sunday morning we had no internet at all. This was a real problem, because I was working from home the next day, and my son needed the iPad for his homework.

First, I tried to fix it myself. I turned the modem off at the wall, waited thirty seconds, and turned it back on. It didn't help. So I called our internet provider. To be honest, I was a bit nervous, because phone calls in English can be hard for me, especially when people speak fast.

The man on the phone was friendly. He asked me to check the lights on the NBN box, and then he ran a line test. He said the fault was on the NBN side, not with my modem, so a technician had to come out. The earliest time was Tuesday morning, between eight and twelve. I asked him to say the time again slowly, and I asked for a reference number and a text message to confirm everything.

In the end, the technician came on Tuesday and fixed the cable in about an hour. The company also put a small credit on our account for the days we were offline. I learned two things. First, it's okay to ask people to slow down. Second, always write down the reference number. Next time, I'll feel much more confident on the phone.
speech.zh: 我想讲一次家里断网的经历。周六晚上网络开始断断续续，到周日早上完全没网了。这很麻烦，因为第二天我要在家办公，儿子也要用平板写作业。我先自己试着把路由器断电重启，但没用，于是给网络运营商打电话。我有点紧张，因为英语电话对我来说比较难，尤其对方说得快的时候。客服很友好，让我看 NBN 盒子上的灯，然后做了线路测试，说故障在 NBN 那边，需要派技术员上门，最早是周二上午 8 点到 12 点。我请他把时间慢慢再说一遍，还要了报修单号和确认短信。最后技术员周二来了，大约一小时就修好了线，公司还给断网的几天减免了一点费用。我学到两点：请别人说慢一点完全没问题；一定要记下单号。下次打电话我会更有信心。

patterns.zh: 描述问题从什么时候开始，如 My internet has been dropping out since last night.

patterns.en: I've already tried ___, but it didn't help.
patterns.zh: 说明你已经试过的办法，省得对方让你重复操作

patterns.en: Just to confirm, the ___ is ___, is that right?
patterns.zh: 复述关键信息（时间、单号、价格）来确认

patterns.en: Could you text / email me the ___, please?
patterns.zh: 请对方把单号、时间等用短信或邮件发给你

lines.en: Thanks for calling SwiftNet, you're speaking with Josh. How're you going today?
lines.zh: 感谢致电 SwiftNet，我是 Josh。今天怎么样？

lines.en: Hi Josh, not too bad, thanks. I'm calling because my home internet has been dropping out since last night, and this morning it stopped working completely.
lines.zh: 你好 Josh，还行，谢谢。我打电话是因为家里的网从昨晚开始一直掉线，今天早上完全用不了了。

lines.en: Oh, that's no good, sorry to hear that. I'll just need to verify a couple of things first. Can I grab the full name on the account?
lines.zh: 哦，那可不好，抱歉。我先核实几件事。账户上的全名是？

lines.en: Sure, it's Amy Wong. That's W-O-N-G.
lines.zh: 好的，Amy Wong，W-O-N-G。

lines.en: Lovely. And the address and date of birth for me?
lines.zh: 好的。再告诉我一下地址和出生日期？

lines.en: It's 22 Wattle Street, Prospect, and my date of birth is the twelfth of March, 1988.
lines.zh: 地址是 Prospect 区 Wattle Street 22 号，生日是 1988 年 3 月 12 日。

lines.en: Perfect, thanks Amy. So you said it's been dropping out — is it the Wi-Fi, or nothing works even with a cable plugged in?
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢 Amy。你说一直掉线——是 Wi-Fi 的问题，还是插网线也完全不行？

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍、慢一点吗？

lines.en: Yeah, no worries. Is it just the Wi-Fi that's not working, or does nothing work, even if you plug a computer straight into the modem with a cable?
lines.zh: 嗯，没问题。是只有 Wi-Fi 不行，还是就算用网线把电脑直接插到路由器上也不行？

lines.en: I tried my laptop with a cable this morning, and it still didn't work. I've already turned the modem off and on, but it didn't help.
lines.zh: 我今天早上用网线接了笔记本，还是不行。我已经把路由器关了再开过，但没用。

lines.en: Righto. Can you have a squiz at the NBN box — that's the white box on the wall, not the modem — and tell me what lights you've got?
lines.zh: 好嘞。你能看一眼 NBN 盒子吗——墙上那个白色盒子，不是路由器——告诉我亮着哪些灯？

lines.en: Okay, I'm looking at it now. The power light is solid green, but the light that says 'Optical' is off.
lines.zh: 好，我在看。电源灯是绿色常亮，但写着 Optical 的那个灯是灭的。

lines.en: Okay, that tells me a fair bit. Give me two ticks, I'll just run a line test from my end. Might take a minute or so.
lines.zh: 好，这说明了不少问题。稍等一下，我从我这边做个线路测试，可能要一分钟左右。

lines.en: Sure, no problem.
lines.zh: 好的，没问题。

lines.en: Yeah, look, the line test's come back with a fault on the NBN side, so it's not your gear. There's no outage in your area, so it's probably the cable to your place. I'll raise a ticket with NBN and get a tech out.
lines.zh: 嗯，线路测试显示故障在 NBN 那边，不是你的设备问题。你那片区域没有大面积停网，所以可能是通到你家的线路。我给 NBN 提交报修单，安排技术员上门。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean a technician has to come to my house?
lines.zh: 确认一下，你的意思是技术员要到我家来？

lines.en: That's right. Earliest I can do is Tuesday, eight till twelve. Someone over eighteen needs to be home to let 'em in, and they might need to get into the garage or the side of the house.
lines.zh: 对。最早能约到周二 8 点到 12 点。需要一个 18 岁以上的人在家开门，他们可能要进车库或者房子侧面。

lines.en: Tuesday morning is fine, I'll be working from home. But what can I do until then? I really need the internet for work tomorrow.
lines.zh: 周二上午可以，我在家办公。但在那之前怎么办？我明天上班真的需要网络。

lines.en: Yeah, fair enough. Your modem's actually got 4G backup, but you need the SIM activated. I can switch that on now, it'll kick in within about fifteen minutes. It's a bit slower, but fine for emails and video calls.
lines.zh: 嗯，可以理解。你的路由器其实有 4G 备用，只是需要激活 SIM 卡。我现在就能开通，大概 15 分钟内生效。速度慢一点，但发邮件、开视频会议没问题。

lines.en: That would be great, thank you. And will I still have to pay for the days without internet?
lines.zh: 那太好了，谢谢。还有，没网的这几天我还要付费吗？

lines.en: Once it's fixed, just give us a call and we can put a credit on your account for the days you were offline.
lines.zh: 修好后给我们打个电话，我们可以把断网那几天的费用作为减免记到你的账户上。

lines.en: Okay. Could I get a reference number, and could you text me the appointment details, please?
lines.zh: 好的。能给我一个报修单号吗？另外能把预约信息发短信给我吗？

lines.en: Course. Your reference number is S-N-four-eight-two-one-seven. I'll text that through to the mobile on the account, and NBN will send you a reminder the day before.
lines.zh: 当然。你的单号是 SN-48217。我会发短信到账户登记的手机上，NBN 也会在前一天发提醒给你。

lines.en: Thanks. So that's SN-48217, Tuesday between eight and twelve. Thanks so much for your help, Josh.
lines.zh: 谢谢。那就是 SN-48217，周二 8 点到 12 点之间。非常感谢你的帮助，Josh。

lines.en: No worries at all, Amy. Sorry again for the hassle. Enjoy the rest of your Sunday!
lines.zh: 不客气，Amy。再次抱歉给你添麻烦了。周日剩下的时间愉快！

rescue.en: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，我没太听清，能慢一点再说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Could you spell that for me, please?
Sorry, which light do you mean — the one on the modem or the NBN box?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，你说的是哪个灯——路由器上的还是 NBN 盒子上的？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, the reference number is ___, is that right?
Could you text or email me the details so I have them in writing?
rescue.zh: 能把详情用短信或邮件发给我吗？这样我有书面记录。

checklist: 我能用一句话说清楚：问题从什么时候开始、现在是什么情况
我听懂了 have a squiz、righto、two ticks、flick it back on 这些澳洲口语
我能描述 NBN 盒子上灯的状态（solid / flashing / off）
我听懂了故障在哪边（on the NBN side）和上门时间段（eight till twelve）
我至少礼貌追问了两次（请对方放慢、确认意思）
我要到了单号、问了备用网络和账单减免，并要求短信确认
